title: Individual choices affect footprint
caption: In relation to carbon emissions and climate change, individual choices can significantly affect one's personal carbon footprint. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Microcosm within world
caption: We are both a microcosm within the world and macrocosms to our own inner systems. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Skin carries standards
caption: From a cultural perspective, the skin carries significant standards. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Flaws bring depth
caption: Perfection can inspire growth and excellence, but a balanced pursuit with the acceptance of imperfections often brings depth, uniqueness and a sense of humanity to experiences. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Growth mindset rewards resilient
caption: A growth mind set rewards the resilient, offering an altered perspective to welcome challenges, and thrive from them. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Challenge viewed as opportunity
caption: The challenge viewed as an opportunity for growth and learning rather than just a setback, allowing one to quickly bounce back from adversity. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Systems adapt
caption: Systems, whether biological or psychological have proven to flourish through overcoming challenges catalyzed by the interplay found between pain and progress. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Stitch the small tear early
caption: What if, however, one simply doesn't catch the small tear, or does so but doesn't stitch it? — from Chapter 1: The one in time in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Sensors gather information
caption: Within our bodies are sensors that gather information from the world body, acting as environmental detectors. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: World is a body
caption: The world is a body and we are its extension—the parts of it that allow it to craft reality into a story with which our own senses can perceive it. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Taste is dialogue
caption: Taste offers an intimate dialogue with the external by adding an inward dimension of touch to detect sensory data beyond temperature and texture, such as flavor. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Mountain climbers
caption: For example, you can see a distant mountain but not hear the conversation of mountain climbers. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: See further than hear
caption: However, it's more logical to discredit this perspective and accept that you can see further than you can hear. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Body is dynamic parchment
caption: The body is flesh bound by skin—a dynamic parchment upon which the story of our senses is inscribed. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Senses evolved
caption: Over millennia, human senses have evolved, finely tuning our interaction with the environment, adapting our boundaries of perception. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Intuition gauged by experience
caption: Intuition, perhaps having the greatest impact on distance, is uniquely gauged by experience and knowledge. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Senses extend beyond skin
caption: We have five senses, each extending our body's limits beyond the skin with the exception of touch. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Individual impact amplified
caption: As such, individual impact is amplified by the recognition of broader systemic changes that support them. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Coral reefs
caption: Coral polyps equally showcase this with the creation of massive reef structures that support entire marine ecosystems. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Bees as pollinators
caption: In nature such similarities are seen with the effect of bees as pollinators which contribute to the reproduction of plants on a global scale. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Butterfly effect
caption: Chaos theory highlights the behavior of complex systems that are highly sensitive to initial conditions, known as the butterfly effect. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Small world
caption: It considers humans as embodying the same forces and elements that govern the cosmos. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Microcosm mirrors macrocosm
caption: The concepts of microcosm and macrocosm describe the relationship between individuals and the universe, suggesting that each small part reflects and influences the whole. — from Chapter 4: Microcosm and macrocosm in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Imperfections contribute to resilience
caption: Many natural phenomena illustrate how imperfections contribute to resilience and function. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Genetic diversity
caption: Biological plurality showcases the advantageous nature of genetic diversity within the environment as perfect genetic makeup doesn't exist. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Perfect models don't exist
caption: Science idealizes models that don't exist in reality, such as a frictionless surface and perfect circles in physics and mathematics. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Wabi-sabi
caption: The Japanese concept of wabi-sabi embraces imperfection as part of the natural order. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Futility of perfection
caption: The futility of pursuing perfection as an objective standard highlights it subjectively as a desirable trait, as it is dependent on perspective. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Perfection varies by culture
caption: Perfection can also be subjective, allowing it to adopt different interpretations across varying cultures, perspectives, and individual beliefs. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Perfection is subjective
caption: Perfection is often attributed to a state of flawlessness; the highest standard of excellence one can ascertain. — from Chapter 3: The elegance of flaws in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Amor fati
caption: Philosophically, the concepts about the rhythms of progress through experiences of adversity can be accentuated by the ideas initially discussed. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Perspective shifts adversity
caption: Embracing this instead of trying to evade it, is what determines whether setbacks are seen as failures or stepping stones toward growth. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Embrace adversity deliberately
caption: Complete embrace of adversity ensures the temporary stop that is stagnation, serves to pave the way for growth. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Resilience born from endurance
caption: It is from this that resilience is born, and individuals can alter their perceptions to a positive and adaptive mindset. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Immediate pain serves purpose
caption: Immediate pain serves a purpose as a crucial protective mechanism in an acute sense, whether emotional or psychological. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Muscles grow through stress
caption: When stressed through exercise, muscles experience micro-tears, and during the recovery period, the body repairs these tears, resulting in stronger, larger muscles. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Adversity clears old growth
caption: The adversity of fire clears old growth, releasing nutrients into the soil and allowing new, diverse flora to flourish. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Forest fires renew
caption: In nature, forest fires are perceived as a destructive force but are part of a natural cycle of renewal. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Pain meets resilience
caption: A common thread can be woven through man and nature as immediate pain meets resilience and growth. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Adversity as precursor
caption: As such, adversity as a precursor to significant development should be synonymous. — from Chapter 2: If you can't evade it, embrace it in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Outcome beyond intention
caption: An outcome far beyond its original "intention". — from Chapter 1: The one in time in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Intend healthy, yearn comfort
caption: For instance, in the human body, we might intend to eat healthy, but unconsciously yearn for comfort foods when stressed. — from Chapter 1: The one in time in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Disconnect between intention and behavior
caption: Consider the disconnect between conscious intention and subconscious behavior. — from Chapter 1: The one in time in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Intention vs subconscious
caption: There is of course, a non-linear, complex relationship that binds one's conscious intention and subconscious actions. — from Chapter 1: The one in time in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Time bomb
caption: A time bomb ticking towards an imminent catastrophe? — from Chapter 1: The one in time in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Small tear
caption: What if, however, one simply doesn't catch the small tear, or does so but doesn't stitch it? — from Chapter 1: The one in time in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Tipping point
caption: Consider our current technological mark as a tipping point, beyond which one can sink if unable to float, metaphorically speaking. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Technology blurs lines
caption: There is an additional consideration: technology blurs the lines of this interplay even further. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Experiences shape being
caption: One's experiences shape one's being. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: I am therefore I think
caption: If one is to flip this on its head, however, "I am, therefore I think," presupposes existence preceding thought. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Perception is a story
caption: One's perception of the world can come in the form of a story through which our senses perceive reality. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Sun on skin
caption: Can the warmth of the sun on our skin bridge the gap between self and the universe? — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: One needs them but they don't need one
caption: One needs them, but they don't need one. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: World body
caption: They are part of the world body, not the human body. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

caption: Some might consider it a bag of bones, unless you're an arthropod, then its chitin. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: Dynamic parchment
caption: The body is flesh bound by skin—a dynamic parchment upon which the story of our senses is inscribed. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.

title: The body marks the boundary
caption: The body, wrapped in flesh, marks the boundary where the physical meets the metaphysical. — from Introduction in The Nine Stitches by M.W.E. Wigman.
